title: Group · Member Profile
note: iPhone side limited by design: MemberProfilePage loads its profile over the NETWORK (GroupActions → GET /api/members/:id/profile), not from AppState, so the harness can only seed the pre-load hero state (name + initials + gradient) — the `hero` variant. Full-content `default` and the `error` variant are WEB-FORWARD. A `pages.member-profile` ViewRegistry case exists (added 2026-07-28) but the app must be rebuilt (user-approved xcodebuild) before any iPhone capture. Avatar omitted → initials render (remote URLs never resolve in snapshots); all dates/durations are pre-formatted deterministic literals.
